Enum Class PaintError

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<PaintError>
dev.despical.pixelpainter.core.PaintError
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<PaintError>, Constable
public enum PaintError extends Enum<PaintError>
Enumerates user-correctable failures and the message each one resolves to.

Replaces free-form error strings so every failure that can reach a command sender is checked by the compiler and mapped to a bundled panel message.
